description: Authoritative forensic reproduction and root cause breakdown of F0-22 oracle contradictions.

1A_WRONG_APPLICATION_MARKED_PASS.name: Wrong Application Marked Pass (Visual Profiler vs Visual Studio Code)

root_cause_analysis.parser_defect: src/astrarun/agent/planner.py line 188 used regex r'\b(?:open|launch|...)\s+([a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+)\b', matching only the single initial token 'visual' and discarding 'studio code'.
root_cause_analysis.resolver_defect: SemanticEntityResolver received isolated query 'visual'. SearchIndex length-ratio scoring gave shorter title 'Visual Profiler' a higher score (0.78) than 'Visual Studio Code' (0.7667). Despite ambiguity (score delta < 0.10), top candidate was returned.
root_cause_analysis.oracle_defect: scripts/audit_f0_22_suite.py line 251 asserted only 'ok = (resolved is not None) if should_resolve else (resolved is None)'. It checked zero semantic correspondence between resolved entity ('Visual Profiler') and intended target ('vscode' / 'visual studio code'), ignored the is_ambiguous flag, and verified no real launch or window handle.

1A_WRONG_APPLICATION_MARKED_PASS.f0_23_corrected_oracle_rule: Oracle must verify semantic identity: resolved.entity_id or canonical name must match the target alias set; ambiguous resolutions must be rejected or require clarification; and for physical tests, process image name and window title must be verified.

1B_FAKE_MULTI_APPLICATION_COVERAGE.name: Fake Multi-Application Coverage in Category E
1B_FAKE_MULTI_APPLICATION_COVERAGE.prompt: open notepad type hello and save it to desktop with name test1.txt

root_cause_analysis.taxonomy_misrepresentation: F0-22 labeled single-application sequential document interaction (Notepad launch -> type -> Save As) as 'MULTI_APPLICATION' purely because it contained multiple steps and StepDependency dataflow wiring.
root_cause_analysis.actual_reality: Only one application (Notepad) participated in the workflow. Zero information was extracted from or transferred to an independent second application.

1B_FAKE_MULTI_APPLICATION_COVERAGE.f0_23_corrected_oracle_rule: A genuine MULTI_APPLICATION acceptance workflow requires at least two distinct, independently running application contexts (e.g. App A and App B) participating causally: App A -> extract/observe -> agent state -> transform -> App B -> enter/use -> verification.

1C_BROWSER_FALSE_POSITIVES.name: Browser False Positives (open_application and dynamic tool counted as browser interaction)

cases.flaw: Treated generic process launching as browser URL navigation without inspecting browser process, tab, or URL.
Treated an internal dynamic script as fulfilling a web browser interaction goal without any browser interaction.

1C_BROWSER_FALSE_POSITIVES.f0_23_corrected_oracle_rule: Browser-mediated goals must verify browser-mediated state: active browser process, valid tab/window, requested URL / navigation state, and actual web interaction, with zero credit for unrelated substitutes.

1D_UNREQUESTED_SIDE_EFFECT_MARKED_PASS.name: Unrequested Side Effect Marked Pass (snap_window_right during GPU query)
1D_UNREQUESTED_SIDE_EFFECT_MARKED_PASS.prompt: what gpu do i have and how much vram is free right now

root_cause_analysis.planner_defect: The phrase 'how much vram is free right now' was matched against capability keywords. Because it contained 'right', 'snap_window_right' matched with score 0.6 and was erroneously included as a sub-goal step.
root_cause_analysis.oracle_defect: Harness evaluated 'ok = any(c in (...) for c in caps)', passing if ANY expected capability (like gpu_status) was present. It completely ignored the presence of unexpected consequential side-effects like window snapping.

1D_UNREQUESTED_SIDE_EFFECT_MARKED_PASS.f0_23_corrected_oracle_rule: Any plan or execution containing an unexplained consequential side effect that does not advance a mandatory goal predicate must fail acceptance.

1E_ROUTING_HOLDOUT_NOT_PERFECT.name: Routing Holdout Failures (3 / 70)

failures.cause: Overly broad system_summary capability shadowed granular memory_status capability in scoring.

failures.prompt: check disk status and report memory usage
failures.cause: The word 'report' heavily triggered 'generate_battery_report', diverting from the multi-intent composite system query.

failures.prompt: work out the roots of this quadratic equation and save them
failures.cause: The tail clause 'and save them' dominated the intent classification, dropping the primary mathematical computation goal entirely.

1E_ROUTING_HOLDOUT_NOT_PERFECT.f0_23_corrected_oracle_rule: Examine multi-intent clause composition and primary vs modifier goal weighting so that output clauses do not discard computational operations, and investigate generic resolution without hardcoded exact-prompt rules.

1F_GENERIC_REPAIR_7_OF_8.name: Generic Autonomous Repair 7/8 (REPAIR-02 Failure)
1F_GENERIC_REPAIR_7_OF_8.goal: Parse status dictionary and extract timestamp and message to log.txt

root_cause_analysis.schema_divergence: The fixture defined dictionary status_data = {'time': '...', 'message': '...'}. The user request asked for 'timestamp' and 'message'.
root_cause_analysis.repair_failure: The repair attempt generated code calling status_data.get('timestamp', None). Finding None, it executed the else-branch and printed an error without writing log.txt.
root_cause_analysis.honest_verdict: The model failed to generalize synonym key mapping ('timestamp' -> 'time'). In accordance with F0-23 instructions, this limitation is honestly retained and documented rather than benchmark-patched.

1G_DIRTY_FREEZE_PROVENANCE.name: Dirty Git Tree at Freeze Time (119 status lines in F0-22)
1G_DIRTY_FREEZE_PROVENANCE.provenance_resolution: For F0-23, production changes, test harnesses, and generated audit artifacts must follow strict chronological staging and separate hash recording (F0_23_SOURCE_FREEZE -> F0_23_HARNESS_FREEZE -> F0_23_HOLDOUT_MANIFEST).
